a family based intervention combining face to face sessions, and social media, was effective in reducing the adiposity of Malay primary school children.

a family based intervention programme using social media in addition to face to face sessions was effective in reducing adiposity of Malay primary school children.

the development of a family based obesity prevention intervention programme for Malay children.
the development of an effective and cost effective family based intervention to reduce obesity among children.
the development of a family based social media intervention for the prevention of child obesity.

a family based intervention programme using face to face and social media is effective in reducing childhood obesity in Malaysia.
the REDUCE intervention is effective in reducing childhood obesity.

we have shown that a family based intervention that uses both social media and face to face sessions is an effective way to reduce adiposity among overweight or obese Malay primary school children in Malaysia.
the Malaysian REDUCE intervention is effective in reducing childhood obesity and the social media component of the intervention was effective in increasing the retention rate of parents and children.
